Current specification adopted in the owner-approved 2026-11-16 continuation. This body supersedes earlier body/notes where inconsistent. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md.

### DL4. Coverage and omission

This is derived from DL3, not asked of a model. For each source row or scene it records which
participants recalled it, with which grades. Coverage is reported per grade, so a row cited
only by contradicted or unverifiable atoms is not counted as recalled. A row with no binding is
"not evidenced as recalled", which is a claim about the record, not proof of an omission; the
report names it that way.

- **Engineering exit:** one independently calculated readout fixture matches the derived
  per-grade coverage and denominator, including unbound, contradicted and unverifiable cases,
  without a model call; no unbound row is labelled a proven omission.
- **Scientific qualification (fresh, joint evaluation):** row-level coverage agrees with human coverage coding on a sample at a
  kappa of at least 0.6, with the denominator stated.

Close this implementation bead only after its engineering acceptance artifact is executed, independently reviewed and its exact commit lands. Closing means implementation ready, never fresh accuracy established. Fresh criteria are retained in the joint human evaluation (protocol bd-01M50KBFT26DRB77VFHPRHYNA2; report bd-01M50KD0NHVPCEHGZND9H18M6E). Thresholds remain proposals to fix before the frozen protocol.
